svg.title: GPT-4 checking itself vs. an outside checker
svg.desc: Graph coloring: Answers alone 16%, GPT-4 checks itself 2%, Outside checker 38%; Game of 24: Answers alone 5%, GPT-4 checks itself 3%, Outside checker 36%; Blocksworld planning: Answers alone 40%, GPT-4 checks itself 55%, Outside checker 60%. Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.08115, Table 1.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: INSTRUMENT READOUT // STECHLY ET AL. (2024) TABLE 1

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif
